generation.wire: Explicit integer 0 <= generation < 2**53; upper bound rejects before the model request
generation.range: The microsecond scale reaches the 53-bit limit after approximately 285 years, not 104 days
generation.production_clock: Original time.monotonic clock, shared across Linux processes within the same board boot; a fresh board boot has a distinct existing board_boot_id owner key
generation.restart: Normal same-boot serialized worker restarts use the current monotonic ordinal instead of rewinding to 1, while the Windows host survives
generation.host_behavior: Host rejects generations below its high-water mark; equal generation is allowed for a unique request ID, while an individual candidate instance advances strictly
generation.concurrency_boundary: Existing production writer lock and one serial idle worker remain required. This stateful summarizer was not and is not a supported concurrent multi-client scheduler. No new owner slots or relaxed host checks are introduced.
generation.rollback: Retain rollback_safe/generation_only.patch while the inference host survives. Reverting to counter-from-1 recreates stale_generation; do not restart models or restore business databases implicitly.

validated_classification: Exact wire version/owner/schema validation happens before reading structured remote error codes
Validated cancelled/preempted/superseded/foreground_busy become InterruptedError and retain original cancelled/no-new-failure backoff handling
Validated deadline_exceeded becomes TimeoutError and the original bounded failure retry policy applies
Unknown code is exported only as other; malformed wire/owner is rejected, never adopted as cancellation
All semantic JSON, protected values, source coverage, scope and Store commit checks remain in force; failure retains bodies

metadata_review.nonblocking_interpretation: summary_diagnostics.state=complete means inference produced a candidate; it is not proof that Store commit/deletion completed. Use worker.completed, durable committed counts and backlog trends for production acceptance.

structural_checks: BoardContextBuilder and BoardMemoryCommands AST exactly unchanged
Original semantic summary __call__ AST equals new _summarize after removing only stage assignments
Backoff _record_failure, _fail_task and step AST exactly unchanged
No Store/schema, cleanup/retention permission, audio guard or ACK modifications in the two reviewed sources

covers: Near and at the wire upper bound
Unknown private token cannot enter diagnostics
Author restart/fake-host and synthetic Store/body retention/classification tests

deployment_acceptance_not_claimed: The historical 270 commits and current 622 backlog do not establish the exact cause of every recent model_failed
A successful source review does not prove production backlog drain or bodyless-event provenance classification
Root remains the only hardware publisher and should observe fixed subcodes plus actual durable commit/backlog changes after publication
